scope.phase_2: create one AEGIS correlation record only if exact provider version is established
scope.phase_3: exactly one version-bound collector read/run only if exact provider version is established
scope.phase_4: raw-first capture and exact-run output inspection
scope.phase_5: offline comparison only; Mission 041B must not be relinked
scope.phase_6: read-only UI version inspection if browser access is stable

conditional_run_authorization.condition: PRODUCTION_VERSION must be an exact provider-recognized value obtained from documented/provider response evidence

target_policy: Use only the canonical target already associated with the collector; no target change is authorized.
fail_closed_rules: Do not guess that v1 is the full provider version identifier.
Do not invent a revision or use an AEGIS-local fallback as provider version.
If exact production version is UNKNOWN, stop without running.
Do not fabricate absent provider identifiers; record NOT_RETURNED_BY_PROVIDER.
Preserve raw provider response before normalization.
historical_evidence_policy: Mission 041B and all prior evidence remain immutable and unchanged.
